title: Scout Recovery Handoff v1
description: Host-authenticated owner and browser-generation claims bound to a portable recovery receipt. The signature does not establish live browser identity or application outcome.
$comment: The Go verifier and independent Node receiver enforce that expires_at is later than issued_at and no more than 15 minutes later. Receivers must also authenticate the owner and compare the signed claims with a fresh trusted broker observation.

browser_generation.description: Host-issued generation token mapped to the actual browser context by a trusted broker.

signature.description: Unpadded base64url HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical Go JSON envelope with signature set to an empty string.
